description: Local income-tax coverage for the pay-run guard (Spec 25 (PAY-120)). 'engine' = the app computes it; 'unsupported' = pay runs are held for employees living (basis residence) or working (basis work) there. A state with no row has no local income tax the employer withholds. Employer-paid-only taxes are not listed. Maintained by the state/local payroll SME; sourceVerified=false means the source has not been fetched live yet and must be before enforcement.
